verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) on NVIDIA's developer portal, which hosts the CUDA Toolkit docs used to program the RTX 5090, so an agent has an entry point. However, the file covers the whole portal rather than this card, and the probe for markdown versions of the docs (cuda-toolkit.md) returned 404, so agent-readable content is limited to the index. Missing for 10: RTX 5090-specific agent-oriented docs, markdown/LLM-friendly versions of doc pages, evidence of the llms.txt content depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
